cards.extra1: equally (adv) — một cách bình đẳng · equality (n) — sự bình đẳng · equalize (v) — làm cho bằng nhau
cards.extra2: Negative: unequal (adj) — không bằng nhau; bất bình đẳng
cards.example: Parents should share household responsibilities equally.

cards.extra1: responsible (adj) — có trách nhiệm · responsibly (adv) — một cách có trách nhiệm
cards.example: Children learn responsibility by helping with household chores.

cards.backContent: appreciate (v) — đánh giá cao; trân trọng
cards.extra1: appreciation (n) — sự cảm kích · appreciative (adj) — biết ơn; biết đánh giá · appreciable (adj) — đáng kể
cards.extra2: Negative: unappreciative (adj) — không biết trân trọng
cards.example: Children should appreciate what their parents do for the family.

cards.extra1: valuable (adj) — có giá trị · invaluable (adj) — vô giá; cực kỳ quý giá
cards.extra2: Negative: valueless (adj) — không có giá trị
cards.example: Doing chores can teach teenagers valuable life skills.

cards.extra1: truthful (adj) — trung thực; đúng sự thật · truthfully (adv) — một cách trung thực
cards.example: It is important to be truthful with family members.

cards.extra1: honesty (n) — tính trung thực · honestly (adv) — một cách trung thực
cards.example: Honesty helps build trust in a family.

cards.backContent: respect (n/v) — sự tôn trọng; tôn trọng
cards.extra1: respectful / respectable / respective (adj) · respectfully (adv) — một cách lễ phép, kính trọng
cards.example: Children should speak respectfully to older family members.
Experienced adults can give teenagers useful advice.

cards.extra1: strong (adj) — mạnh · strengthen (v) — củng cố · strongly (adv) — mạnh mẽ
cards.example: Sharing family activities can strengthen family bonds.

cards.extra1: spotlessly (adv) — sạch không tì vết; hoàn toàn sạch
cards.example: She keeps the kitchen spotlessly clean.
